nature: AI-generated original high-resolution source (1254x1254) with soft alpha; NOT hand-placed native pixel art. Fictional designed nursery furniture/structures, not historical or architectural reconstruction; the shelter sign is blank (no operator, route or station name).

assets.layout: nominal 2x2 (627px cells): seed_saving_table, dye_table / community_flower_trellis, nursery_shuttle_shelter. Objects are NOT on the equal-cell grid: the shelter starts at x606, left of the x627 line, so equal cells would clip it.

native_size_decision: Proposed 64x48 tables rejected: the table silhouettes are ~1.07-1.15 w/h, so 64x48 would mean squashing or a 51x48 squat sprite. Both tables use one shared scale and are 64x56. Trellis 64x64 and shelter 80x80 keep the proposed footprints. Scales differ slightly (9.5 / 9.0 / 8.0 source px per native px) to honour the proposed world footprints; the source itself has no reliable shared scale.
integration: Byte-for-byte copy (sha256 equal to source); no pixel edits, no Python/Pillow image editing, no geometry stand-ins. scripts/flower_scene_art.gd blits each prop's window from its own quadrant clip onto a transparent canvas (Godot Image.blit_rect; overhang stays transparent, so neighbours and stray haze never leak in), then resizes to the native size with Image.INTERPOLATE_NEAREST and caches per ID (same get_region/resize pipeline family as flower_art.gd and bakery_art.gd). Windows keep native aspect exactly, are centred on the measured bounds (<=1 source px off) and bottom-anchored 2-4 source px under the feet. Godot import: lossless (compress/mode=0), no mipmaps.
alpha_measurement: Source has broad faint haze (alpha 1-8) across the canvas, including the gutters; visible content (alpha>8) never touches any clip border and lies fully inside each window. At native size each prop keeps 158-475 ghost pixels (alpha 1-7, visually invisible) and 31-109 fringe pixels (alpha 8-63). See work/flowers/props-check/test-output.txt.
status: Native 1x/4x galleries on grass and soil reviewed (work/flowers/props-check). Acceptable as a display-only adapter. Native pixel validation is still PENDING: soft alpha edges and nearest downsampling of a non-native source mean small details (seed envelopes, sieve, shears) turn into noisy clusters. This is not production-certified pixel art. In-world review on real tiles at real camera zoom has not been done.
